The '''clan''' of [[Brrik]] was a family of six [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. After the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] destroyed their home, the clan began to work for the [[Shock Drum]] project in exchange for a place to live.
